title: Supplier disruption
situation: A primary supplier has been disrupted while demand has increased by 30%. The organisation has five days of inventory remaining and needs replacement supply within seven days.
decision_conflict: Lowest cost versus fastest replenishment

title: Primary supplier disruption
situation: The primary supplier has suspended shipments while a distribution center has limited coverage.
decision_conflict: Immediate availability versus supplier reliability

title: Procurement cost spike
situation: Market prices have risen sharply and the buyer must protect budget without creating avoidable continuity risk.
decision_conflict: Budget savings versus operational resilience

title: Supplier quality alert
situation: A quality alert raises the chance that incoming components will fail inspection.
decision_conflict: Low price versus quality assurance

title: Seasonal demand surge
situation: Forecast demand is rising ahead of a seasonal peak and replenishment capacity may become constrained.
decision_conflict: Scalable capacity versus dependable delivery

title: Transport strike
situation: Industrial action threatens the usual freight corridor and alternative routes have different cost and service profiles.
decision_conflict: Cheap transport versus fast reliable routing

title: Perishable goods
situation: Temperature-sensitive goods need replenishment and a cold-chain excursion could make the shipment unusable.
decision_conflict: Cost savings versus cold-chain protection

title: Single-source dependency
situation: A critical item is sourced from one supplier and leadership is considering a diversified replenishment strategy.
decision_conflict: Lowest cost versus supplier diversification

title: Port congestion
situation: Congestion at the main port threatens inbound stock during rising demand.
decision_conflict: Lower freight cost versus route reliability

title: Component allocation shortage
situation: A component manufacturer has allocated less capacity than the planned order.
decision_conflict: Secure capacity versus protect purchase cost

title: Currency volatility
situation: A sharp currency movement has changed import costs before the next replenishment cycle.
decision_conflict: Lock in price versus maintain flexible supply

title: Supplier product recall
situation: A supplier recall notice requires the buyer to replace a potentially affected batch.
decision_conflict: Fast replacement versus stronger quality assurance

title: Flooded distribution center
situation: Flooding has restricted access to a distribution center and its normal replenishment route.
decision_conflict: Immediate rerouting versus minimize emergency cost

title: Production labor shortage
situation: A labor shortage at a key supplier may reduce its output during a critical production window.
decision_conflict: Supplier capacity versus dependable delivery

title: Cold-chain capacity constraint
situation: Refrigerated transport capacity is limited for a temperature-sensitive replenishment.
decision_conflict: Protect product integrity versus control shipping cost

title: Supplier systems outage
situation: A supplier systems outage has interrupted order visibility and shipment confirmations.
decision_conflict: Restore visibility versus diversify supply

title: New product launch
situation: A new product launch requires an initial component build with uncertain demand.
decision_conflict: Keep launch cost low versus protect launch availability

title: Supplier consolidation
situation: A proposed consolidation would reduce the supplier base but increase concentration exposure.
decision_conflict: Scale economies versus sourcing resilience

title: Customs documentation hold
situation: A documentation issue has held an imported shipment while the receiving site approaches reorder point.
decision_conflict: Use local stock versus wait for lower-cost imports

title: Capacity ramp-up
situation: A planned production ramp requires a larger replenishment than current supplier forecasts.
decision_conflict: Scale quickly versus limit supplier execution risk

title: Packaging material shortage
situation: A packaging-material shortage threatens finished-goods dispatch during a promotion.
decision_conflict: Low unit cost versus protect dispatch schedule

title: Winter route disruption
situation: Severe winter weather may disrupt the usual transport corridor to a remote depot.
decision_conflict: Route dependability versus short lead time

title: Perishable inventory expiry
situation: A short remaining shelf life requires replenishment in smaller, more frequent shipments.
decision_conflict: Reduce spoilage risk versus capture bulk savings

title: Supplier emissions requirement
situation: A new procurement policy requires lower-emission transport without missing the delivery window.
decision_conflict: Meet sustainability policy versus preserve cost and speed
